newsitem.title: USA: Shuffle Master says court denies injunction.
newsitem.headline: Shuffle Master says court denies injunction.

text.p: Shuffle Master Inc said Tuesday a federal court in Jackson, Mississippi, denied a request from Progressive Games Inc seeking to block its Let It Ride The Tournament poker game.
The company said Progressive Games had filed a lawsuit accusing Shuffle Master of infringing on some of its patents.
The ruling will allow the Let It Ride game to continue operating until the suit is resolved, the company said.
Shuffle Master provides shuffler systems and proprietary table games and video games to the casino industry.
Its shares were trading down 1/8 Tuesday at 9-5/8.
